source.rule_text: Total carried forward balance, with a maximum of 10 days up to March 31st,

rules.balance: (LL - PDO) + (carried + entitlement - half_days - CL - V) + (LLPH - PDOPH)

codes.LLPH: Leave in Lieu of Public Holiday
codes.PDOPH: Worked Public Holiday on a Public Holiday

reconciliation.note: the derivation reproduces the workbook's own formula; rows listed as stale have a cached Balance Due that no longer matches that formula, because the day grid is maintained by hand and edited without a recalculation
